scope: Studio-authored source-specific planning facts for native GPU-Sampling inputs; not an executable/source build attestation, artifact check or scientific validation. Read current source_evidence. If stale/unregistered/blocked, treat as conceptual reference; never claim current syntax/defaults.

applicability.source_match: Only exact registered file hashes support source-specific authoring. Commit alone does not cover dirty files.
applicability.selected_executable_support: not_run unless separately evidenced; no source/build equality inferred
applicability.execution_gates: This reference adds no requirement to prove compiled source/build correspondence and no arbitrary compatibility precondition. Report unknown provenance as not_run; actual execution remains governed by existing target artifact/runtime, project authorization and current user delegation and required artifact/runtime checks. Unknown provenance never creates a user-internal required field or justifies leaving mechanically authorable inputs absent; no real target compatibility gate is weakened.

run_in.serialization: Whitespace-delimited native commands; use actual authorized input basenames. Preserve potential/structure/bias/manifest identities and selected backend. Do not emit Python or nested YAML as run.in.
nve_ordered_grammar: <requested native output commands, if supported by their own source contract>
run_in.scope: This reference gives NVE and independent OPES grammar. Other ensembles/output commands need their own current native contract; do not infer PyDyn keyword equivalence. Use one run block for a requested single bounded run.

route_selection.opes: OPES; accepts model+config and optional checkpoint; duplicate OPES rejected
route_selection.metad_or_cvonly: GASMD (MetaD accepted alias); not an equivalent OPES state ABI
route_selection.restart: Fresh state: omit checkpoint operand, do not import ABI/FD history as MD state. Optional selected checkpoint overrides configured state output path and requires its matching atomic restart; do not claim restart parity from a fresh smoke.

seed_policy.authoring: Source-confirmed syntax permits a planned seed line for a where-supported request. Label selected executable support/build relation not_run; do not claim seed accepted, fixed or deterministic before execution evidence.
seed_policy.explicit_target_first_condition: If the user expressly requires a successful target test before inserting seed, retain only that specific compatibility decision; author the other native input content. Do not silently call support absent or alter the scientific conditions.
seed_policy.structure_velocities: Existing model.xyz velocities take precedence over velocity initialization temperature/seed. Preserve the supplied structure and report this case; do not silently replace its velocities.

gascfg.serialization: One flat key: value per line. Emit simple unquoted safe basenames for shared path keys. This native subset is not nested/full YAML. Do not emit task parameter aliases as native keys.
value_priority: actual selected manifest/structure evidence when the field/schema exists
explicitly labelled matching source default or technical proposal; never mix C++ parser and writer CLI defaults

max_cv_nums.meaning: Common history capacity required by current adapter; NOT OPES kernel capacity

cv_size.from: actual ordered serialized CV dimension; must match task/manifest

cv_storage_interval.meaning: Common/legacy history setting; NOT OPES deposition PACE

cv_change_interval.meaning: Common parser/adapter compatibility field; NOT an OPES update stride

cv_log_interval.meaning: Native OPES evaluated_step log cadence; map a user log-stride intent here only when that is the intended native meaning

neighbor_rc.from: actual selected CV cutoff coverage; do not lower the requested cutoff

max_neighbors.from: actual manifest/selected construction bound when present, else measured technical evidence or labelled capacity proposal; not atom-count folklore

cv_log_path.meaning: OPES column log output; set explicitly instead of inheriting common GASCVlog.txt

opes_max_kernels.from: actual selected model/manifest capacity and user request; must agree; never use max_cv_nums instead

opes_state_interval.meaning: 0 disables periodic OPES state checkpoints; no exact continuation claim without positive paired state/atomic checkpoints and replay evidence

opes_stop_on_status.meaning: Do not enable scientific stop/basin behavior without the intended model status definition

opes_stop_status.meaning: 0 selects any nonzero model status when stop_on_status is enabled

source_defaults_not_automatic_choices.policy: Prefer real manifest evidence (including its actual max_neighbors) and supplied values. Defaults here are observations, not measured neighbor safety or production settings. Keep consequential proposals explicit.

do_not_serialize: pace: OPES model/artifact-owned parameter, not a GAScfg key
printstride: an intent label, not an inspected OPES native config or base.OPESProcedure key
nested dynamics/validation/review/units objects: not native parser keys

fresh_state_and_logs.initialization: Native backend runner obtains exact initial OPES state through initialize_opes_state and sets the next evaluated step to0. This does not assume every selected backend calls the same raw model method; honor its explicit state/manifest/toolchain contract and never fall back. Fresh pyGAS first-update flag suppresses the first deposition. Never seed it from validation history.
fresh_state_and_logs.integration_vs_evaluation: N native integrations have an additional initial force evaluation before the loop in this source. Native OPES counter advances per non-restart-refresh evaluation, not per log row. Preserve user N, time step and physical duration; do not add integration steps to fit expected rows.
fresh_state_and_logs.deposition: After first update, deposition requires step % model.pace ==0 and passes adaptive-bandwidth waiting/exclusion conditions. Kernel logs require deposited>=0.5. Candidate counts are source expectations, not observations.
fresh_state_and_logs.interpretation: Read actual FIELDS header and rows. State/termination/capacity errors can shorten a run. rct/zed are diagnostics, not reweighting offsets. No exact deposition count, stability, deterministic seed or physical convergence is established by this reference.

authoring_completion: Use existing authorized write_project_input with CAS for changed files, then read_project_input for actual bytes/SHA. Publish those native inputs in the same task with original artifact, CV atom selection and units. General target compatibility remains a review/runtime gate, not a reason to leave mechanically authorable files absent. Do not load artifacts, call helper commands, probe, Prepare or execute during draft-only authoring.
